services.desc: Sunset Lake is unlike any place you’ve experienced but when you arrive you’ll feel at home. There is a sense of wonder that you feel as you stand beneath a towering cedar tree or sit by the lake and soak up the afternoon sun. We offer comfortable housing, flexible meeting spaces, and amazing opportunities for rest and adventures for our retreat season guests. services.name: Day Camp
services.desc: Sunset Lake is thrilled to offer one week of day camp designed for children who are too young or just not ready to enjoy the full overnight camp experience. If you’re looking for a summer day camp near you, this exciting program is a dynamic mix of fun and learning. Our Day Camps run Monday through Friday with easy daily drop off and pick up (9:00 AM morning drop off and 5:15 PM pick up) to fit seamlessly into your day. Make the most of your child’s summer and register them for Sunset Lake’s day camp! Looking for an overnight camp experience for your child? Check them out HERE. services.name: Trail Rides
services.desc: Our horseback riding lesson program offers a safe and exciting environment for beginner to intermediate riders. The program is based on a 10-level curriculum that lets riders earn certificates as they progress! Lessons take place in a large outdoor arena and our horses have a range of abilities from jumping to barrel racing, so you can learn different riding styles depending on your interests.
